text: Experts believe that artificial intelligence will change our world in many ways. Today's AI can only do specific tasks, like translating languages or driving cars. However, researchers are working on Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), a machine that could think and learn like a human. AGI might bring great benefits, such as curing diseases and solving climate problems. At the same time, it could be risky if we lose control of it. Some scientists predict AGI may arrive within 20 to 50 years, while others think it is much further away. Nobody knows for sure, but the future of AI will certainly affect all of us.
